mapper.sql: id, product_name, category, brand, price, stock, sale_status, brand_id, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_trade_product ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM lab_trade_product AND category=#{category}AND price >= #{minimum}AND product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY price DESC, id ASC
SELECT FROM lab_trade_product ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_trade_product SET stock=#{stock} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT l.id AS line_id, o.order_no, c.customer_name, p.product_name, p.category, l.quantity, l.deal_price, l.quantity*l.deal_price AS subtotal, o.ordered_on, o.order_status FROM lab_trade_order_line l INNER JOIN lab_trade_order o ON l.order_id=o.id INNER JOIN lab_trade_product p ON l.product_id=p.id INNER JOIN lab_trade_customer c ON o.customer_id=c.id
mapper.select: AND o.order_status=#{status}AND c.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{customer},'%') ORDER BY o.ordered_on DESC,o.id,l.id
SELECT o.id,o.order_no,c.customer_name,o.ordered_on,o.order_status FROM lab_trade_order o JOIN lab_trade_customer c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.id=#{id}
SELECT o.id,o.order_no,c.customer_name,o.ordered_on,o.order_status FROM lab_trade_order o JOIN lab_trade_customer c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.id=#{id} ORDER BY o.id

SELECT p.category AS 分类,SUM(l.quantity) AS 成交件数,SUM(l.quantity*l.deal_price) AS 成交金额 FROM lab_trade_order_line l JOIN lab_trade_order o ON l.order_id=o.id JOIN lab_trade_product p ON l.product_id=p.id WHERE o.order_status='已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 成交金额 DESC,p.category
SELECT p.*,b.id AS b_id,b.brand_name AS b_brand_name,b.website AS b_website FROM lab_trade_product p LEFT JOIN lab_trade_brand b ON p.brand_id=b.id ORDER BY p.id

SELECT b.id AS brand_id,b.brand_name,COUNT(p.id) AS product_count,COALESCE(SUM(p.price),0) AS total_price,COALESCE(AVG(p.price),0) AS average_price,COALESCE(MAX(p.price),0) AS max_price,COALESCE(MIN(p.price),0) AS min_price FROM lab_trade_brand b LEFT JOIN lab_trade_product p ON b.id=p.brand_id GROUP BY b.id,b.brand_name ORDER BY b.id
